adjudication.depicted_input: Instruction-construction template showing the human-written task description prompt with the inserted `[Cell_sentence]` input and target output scaffold used for ChatCell fine-tuning.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for the listed fine-tuning route. It visibly shows the route-specific model input object: a natural-language instruction template containing a human-written task description plus the inserted `[Cell_sentence]` field, which matches the paper’s described description-to-GPT-3.5turbo fine-tuning interface. Under the atlas rules, training/fine-tuning inputs are valid, and a visible model box is not required when the input scaffold itself is clearly depicted. Although the crop also includes adjacent vocabulary-adaptation content, the instruction-construction block remains clearly identifiable and supports the route.
